proposition: Attribute each requested repair to a claimed event and an applicable coverage before requesting insurance recognition.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Entire policy, declarations, insuring clause, wind/hail provisions, exclusions, concurrent-cause language, resulting-loss exceptions and endorsements.
calculation_dependency: Allocate line costs among accepted loss, disputed loss and unrelated work; never count the same repair twice.
requested_change: Identify accepted scope and request itemized reconsideration of specifically documented additional event-related damage.
strongest_carrier_response: Wear, faulty installation, prior loss or another excluded cause explains the condition.
supported_reply: Compare physical findings, chronology and alternative causes; request the exact exclusion and factual basis. Keggi supplies a general burden framework, not proof that this loss is covered.
concession_or_failure_condition: No event linkage, exclusion applies, or policy period unconfirmed: keep amount unasserted and seek qualified review.

proposition: Correct measurable geometry and quantity errors independently of unresolved coverage.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Relevant estimate line definitions, scope basis, policy valuation clause.
calculation_dependency: delta_base = round(q_requested * unit_price_requested,2) - round(q_carrier * unit_price_carrier,2); SF/SQ conversion must be explicit.
requested_change: Revise named quantities and carry only resulting supported changes through estimate totals.
strongest_carrier_response: Measurements differ because one is plan area, includes pitch/waste, or measures excluded surfaces.
supported_reply: Reconcile the same surface, unit and included operations; show arithmetic and measurement uncertainty.
concession_or_failure_condition: No compatible measurement basis or already-included quantity: narrow or withdraw.

proposition: Add an omitted damaged component only when its condition, location and repair need are documented.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Covered-property definition, direct physical loss provision and relevant exclusions.
calculation_dependency: Additional component cost less any overlapping allowance; no unsupported zero carrier allowance.
requested_change: Add or revise the exact line with cross-referenced exhibit and dollar delta.
strongest_carrier_response: Condition is cosmetic, pre-existing, or already paid under another line.
supported_reply: Show function affected, timing and where the proposed operation differs from the existing allowance.
concession_or_failure_condition: No physical support or duplication: omit the increment.

proposition: A shingle replacement request should establish why a bounded compliant repair cannot restore the documented damaged area.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Repair/replacement valuation language, cosmetic limits, relevant manufacturer instructions and applicable local code.
evidence_needed: Authorized representative test documentation where appropriate
calculation_dependency: Compare localized repair, facet replacement and wider replacement on a common scope; replacement is an alternative, not additive to repair.
requested_change: Revise to the smallest supported feasible scope or request joint reinspection.
strongest_carrier_response: Age/brittleness alone is unrelated deterioration; individual units can be repaired.
supported_reply: Explain observed failure mechanism and limits of any test; isolate weather damage from aging and show why the alternative fails.
concession_or_failure_condition: Repair succeeds, test is unrepresentative, or expanded scope lacks policy support: retain repair or mark disputed.

proposition: Discontinued tile supports a documented availability/compatibility investigation, not automatic whole-roof payment.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Like-kind/quality wording, undamaged-property matching endorsement, repair clause and actual code/manufacturer criteria.
calculation_dependency: Cost feasible repair sourcing and limited alternatives; include freight only once and justify quantity.
requested_change: Recognize the documented feasible scope or identify a technically compatible available alternative.
strongest_carrier_response: Usable salvage or compatible tile is available; matching undamaged property is excluded.
supported_reply: Separate functional incompatibility from appearance; assess carrier-proposed sources and acknowledge an applicable matching exclusion.
concession_or_failure_condition: Compatible available material enables repair or claim rests solely on excluded appearance: narrow request.

proposition: Low-slope roofing scope requires system-specific evidence for repair, coating, recover or replacement.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Covered-peril/exclusion provisions; identified system manufacturer repair details; applicable code and limits.
calculation_dependency: Compare bounded repair and replacement alternatives; separate dry/undamaged areas, tear-off layers, insulation and deck quantities.
requested_change: Revise only supported system components or request further inspection.
strongest_carrier_response: Ponding, maintenance or deterioration causes the problem; repair/recoat is feasible.
supported_reply: Tie scope to documented event-related conditions and explain the alternatives and uncertainty.
concession_or_failure_condition: Unknown system or unsupported extent/causation: hold expanded scope.

proposition: A cosmetic matching request remains policy-specific and legally unresolved until the full endorsement record is reviewed.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Matching/undamaged-property exclusions; like-kind/quality wording; notices and renewal endorsements.
evidence_needed: Actual HOA written rule/decision if relied on
calculation_dependency: Keep any undamaged-area matching increment separate from required physical repair and code cost.
requested_change: Request a written policy position on a separately priced matching increment.
strongest_carrier_response: Clear matching exclusion bars replacement of undamaged material, including discontinued products.
supported_reply: Address the actual wording and notice evidence; Hanks and Trudel demonstrate fact-sensitive disputes, not guaranteed success. Counsel owns any enforceability argument.
concession_or_failure_condition: Applicable exclusion or no policy basis: no matching entitlement asserted; HOA preference alone does not establish coverage.

proposition: A code-based scope request must identify the authority having jurisdiction and the precise triggered requirement.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Adopted code edition, local amendment, roof section, permit/transition rule and applicability to this work.
calculation_dependency: Incremental necessary code work only; avoid including the same upgrade in base repair and ordinance/law schedules.
requested_change: Add the specific required construction operation subject to coverage analysis.
strongest_carrier_response: Wrong municipality/edition, repair exception, or requirement not triggered.
supported_reply: Provide jurisdiction/date/section/application chain; Phoenix adoption alone does not establish a roof-specific obligation.
concession_or_failure_condition: No verified applicable code trigger: classify as optional upgrade, not mandated cost.

proposition: Construction-code compliance and insurer payment under ordinance/law coverage are separate questions.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Ordinance/law insuring provision, exclusions, endorsement, sublimit and incurred-cost conditions.
calculation_dependency: Separate base covered repair from incremental code cost; track ordinance/law sublimit and payments independently.
requested_change: Request a distinct ordinance/law determination and estimate allocation.
strongest_carrier_response: Coverage absent, limited, not incurred, or upgrade not caused by covered repair.
supported_reply: Match each incremental operation to verified code trigger and exact policy grant; show remaining sublimit.
concession_or_failure_condition: Coverage/condition absent: disclose owner-funded or unresolved amount rather than relabeling it base repair.

proposition: Underlayment, flashing and accessories must be supported by their actual replacement or detach/reset need.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Loss settlement scope, manufacturer instructions and applicable code.
calculation_dependency: Deduct quantities already included in tear-off, roofing or component prices; distinguish detach/reset from replacement.
requested_change: Correct specifically omitted necessary operations.
strongest_carrier_response: Accessories can be reused or are bundled into other prices.
supported_reply: Show physical condition and inclusion/exclusion of each proposed operation.
concession_or_failure_condition: Safe compliant reuse or bundled cost demonstrated: remove duplicate.

proposition: Waste and collateral breakage should follow measured geometry and a documented method.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Estimate item definitions and applicable repair/replacement wording.
calculation_dependency: Installed quantity + supported waste minus included waste; distinguish event damage from unavoidable repair collateral and contractor-caused damage.
requested_change: Use supported waste/breakage allowance or reserve a documented supplement.
strongest_carrier_response: Flat percentage inflated, already included, or reflects avoidable workmanship loss.
supported_reply: Explain calculation and assumptions; replace assumptions with actual evidence when available.
concession_or_failure_condition: No support or double counting: reduce; do not claim a universal percentage.

proposition: A local unit-price revision requires comparable dated market evidence.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Policy reasonable repair cost wording and applicable estimate assumptions.
calculation_dependency: Recalculate quantity × supported rate; isolate taxes, freight, equipment and labor already included.
requested_change: Revise named rates with a transparent market/date basis.
strongest_carrier_response: Database price is adequate; quote is premium specification, stale or includes extras.
supported_reply: Normalize specifications, date and inclusions; identify why quoted work is necessary and obtainable at that price.
concession_or_failure_condition: Noncomparable quote or unsupported premium: retain supported rate. No authority found making either estimate database conclusive.

proposition: Overhead and profit must be justified under the policy and actual repair organization.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Loss settlement wording, estimate inclusions and relevant coverage position.
calculation_dependency: Apply only supported percentages or dollars to the stated eligible base; show sequential versus common-base calculation; prevent double markup.
requested_change: Recognize substantiated general contracting cost or provide itemized reason for exclusion.
strongest_carrier_response: Single-trade project or embedded overhead/profit already accounts for it.
supported_reply: Explain actual coordination and cost structure; do not claim an automatic three-trade or 10-and-10 rule.
concession_or_failure_condition: No need, duplicate cost, or incompatible policy language: narrow or withdraw.

proposition: Tax, permit and disposal corrections need the correct taxable/chargeable base and actual local evidence.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Applicable policy terms; verified tax treatment, municipal fee schedule and vendor charges.
evidence_needed: Applicable tax guidance reviewed by qualified person
calculation_dependency: Do not tax all labor automatically; separately calculate verified bases and rates, then remove embedded or duplicate charges.
requested_change: Revise specific supported cost components.
strongest_carrier_response: Tax classification or rate is wrong, or fee already included.
supported_reply: Supply the actual applicable authority and arithmetic; this run establishes no Arizona tax rate or project tax classification.
concession_or_failure_condition: Missing tax/fee verification: hold amount as unresolved.

proposition: Emergency mitigation should be documented separately from permanent repair and coverage assurances.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Duties after loss, reasonable protection/temporary repair coverage and post-storm restrictions.
calculation_dependency: Reasonable emergency cost less overlapping permanent repair allowance and prior payment.
requested_change: Recognize supported mitigation or ask for a coverage determination.
strongest_carrier_response: Work unnecessary, excessive, destructive of evidence or unrelated.
supported_reply: Show immediate risk, limited intervention, charges and preserved evidence; emergency work permission is not insurance coverage.
concession_or_failure_condition: Unnecessary or unsupported work: do not describe it as insured mitigation.

proposition: Review labor depreciation against the actual ACV wording and applicable Walker analysis.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: ACV/depreciation definitions, roof schedule and all amendments; exact labor/material breakout.
calculation_dependency: Compare carrier ACV with a policy-consistent recalculation; distinguish future repair labor from value embedded in pre-loss property.
requested_change: Request reversal or explanation of identified labor depreciation only if the policy/authority analysis supports it.
strongest_carrier_response: Different endorsement expressly addresses labor or different valuation method controls.
supported_reply: Compare the actual contract to Walker ¶¶ 4, 23–29; obtain counsel review of material differences.
concession_or_failure_condition: No labor depreciation, materially different controlling wording, or unclear components: hold legal conclusion.

proposition: Recoverable depreciation is conditional and must remain separate from nonrecoverable depreciation.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Replacement-cost eligibility, repair completion/notice deadlines, actual expenditure cap, roof settlement schedule.
calculation_dependency: Remaining recoverable holdback = approved recoverable depreciation minus prior release, further constrained by actual policy terms; never release nonrecoverable amounts by arithmetic alone.
requested_change: Request eligible release or clarification of the outstanding condition and amount.
strongest_carrier_response: Repair not completed, deadline unmet, costs lower, or roof endorsement settles at ACV.
supported_reply: Provide actual completion/cost/extension evidence and distinguish disputed condition from mathematical error.
concession_or_failure_condition: Conditions unmet or amount nonrecoverable: no present payment demand for that holdback.

proposition: Reconcile gross scope, coverage valuation, deductible, limits and payments in separate ledgers.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Deductible amount/basis, coverage limits/sublimits, settlement formula and allocation of payments.
calculation_dependency: Gross estimate delta is not net payment. Determine policy-consistent entitlement before subtracting applicable prior payments once; order of deductible and limit operations is policy-specific.
requested_change: Correct the settlement worksheet only after the gross scope and policy inputs are reconciled.
strongest_carrier_response: Prior payment, separate coverage or deductible already accounts for the requested amount.
supported_reply: Crosswalk every payment to coverage/date/gross-versus-net basis; show residual uncertainty explicitly.
concession_or_failure_condition: Missing statements, negative/unexplained balance, or no coverage: no amount owed asserted.

proposition: A handling inquiry should identify the exact trigger and requested response without inventing a payment deadline.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: R20-6-801(E), (F), (G)(1); relevant loss payment clause.
calculation_dependency: No automatic dollar increase; 10/15 working-day and 30/45 day tracking require separate event fields.
requested_change: Ask for an itemized response, investigation status or written coverage explanation.
strongest_carrier_response: Communication did not reasonably require reply, proof was incomplete, or more investigation is reasonably needed.
supported_reply: Supply receipt/trigger evidence and request identified missing information; acknowledge permitted extensions and limitations.
concession_or_failure_condition: Trigger unproved or exception applies: do not allege breach or use suggested dates as legal deadlines.

proposition: A joint reinspection can resolve identified physical disagreements while preserving competing positions.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Policy inspection/cooperation provisions and role/permission limits.
calculation_dependency: No immediate monetary demand; resulting findings map to line deltas in the next revision.
requested_change: Schedule a joint inspection focused on listed issues, preserving originals and proposed tests.
strongest_carrier_response: No new evidence, access unavailable, or destructive test unacceptable.
supported_reply: Explain the unanswered observation and proposed non-destructive approach; obtain informed permission for any separate testing.
concession_or_failure_condition: Unsafe access or unauthorized testing: stop inspection step and use qualified personnel.

proposition: Appraisal is a policy-governed valuation option whose scope must preserve unresolved coverage issues.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: Actual appraisal clause, demand conditions, deadlines, appraiser qualifications, cost allocation and submission agreement.
calculation_dependency: Itemize valuation by coverage-disputed and undisputed category; award does not automatically equal net insurer payment.
requested_change: Have homeowner and qualified adviser assess appraisal; consider an itemized submission.
strongest_carrier_response: Dispute concerns excluded causes/coverage or demand is untimely or waived.
supported_reply: Hanson limits authority; Chew illustrates itemization preserving coverage questions, subject to actual clause and facts.
concession_or_failure_condition: No appraisal clause, unresolved scope/legal issue or unsuitable cost: do not issue automatic demand.

proposition: Administrative complaint and legal remedies should follow a documented issue, without promises of recovery.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: A.R.S. § 20-461(A), (D); current DIFI procedure to be independently verified; policy suit limits.
calculation_dependency: No damages calculation or promised regulator award; distinguish disputed estimate amount from alleged statutory remedy.
requested_change: Owner may seek regulatory review of documented handling and consult counsel for rights, deadlines and remedies.
strongest_carrier_response: Complaint concerns a legitimate factual/coverage disagreement rather than regulatory misconduct.
supported_reply: Identify the specific handling concern fairly and attach both positions; acknowledge regulator and court roles differ.
concession_or_failure_condition: No supported misconduct or unresolved procedure: seek clarification; no bad-faith label or threat.

proposition: Contractor communication requires a role, permission and compensation check before a packet is released.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: §§ 20-321, 20-321.01, 20-321.02 and 32-1158.02(L); current legal-practice rules.
calculation_dependency: No claim amount; communication compensation must not be hidden in a contingent fee or unexplained markup.
requested_change: Use a technical estimate explanation within verified authority; route settlement/legal positions to the owner or authorized professional.
strongest_carrier_response: Preparer is negotiating for compensation or combining adjusting with repairs.
supported_reply: Show actual limited conduct and permission; an unsupported label or zero separate fee does not resolve indirect compensation or conflict concerns.
concession_or_failure_condition: Unresolved authority, compensated communication or forbidden repair/adjuster overlap: no contractor-authored settlement position.

proposition: Apply the correct statutory version to the relevant events and preserve post-storm contract protections.
rule_or_policy_text_needed: 2026 Ch. 157; general effective date; § 1-244; §§ 32-1158 and 32-1158.02.
calculation_dependency: Separate contract sums, insurance amounts, refundable payments and supported emergency charges; never use a deductible rebate to balance the ledger.
requested_change: Complete applicable disclosures/role controls and obtain review of any older-claim/new-conduct transition.
strongest_carrier_response: Special statutory scope or effective-date condition is not established.
supported_reply: Document each trigger; do not treat every storm as insurer-designated catastrophic or apply 2026 amendments retroactively by default.
concession_or_failure_condition: Missing triggering dates or scope: flag statutory applicability unresolved and follow conservative role controls pending review.
